QuestInfo.name: Treasure Map Hunt Day 1
QuestInfo.0: If you collect 6 pieces of the pirate's Treasure Map at least twice a day and bring them to Cassandra, you can mark your progress in the Pirate King's Treasure Map Book. Today is the 1st day of treasure map hunting. Mark your progress for 7 consecutive days to receive an awesome gift!

0.0: #b#h0##k! I was able to assemble the treasure map from the pieces you brought me, so I was just about to leave to claim my treasure. Since I'm going to be crazy rich soon, I should probably give you a little something for helping me out. Would you like it now?

no.0: Okay, then. Let me know if you want it.

yes.0: This is only the beginning, you know! There are still a TON of pirate treasures out there. Keep bringing me the treasure maps each day, okay?
